Genesis.title: Genesis — Tree of Life and Globe — בראשית
Genesis.description: God creates the world, establishes humanity, and begins His covenant relationship with His people.

Exodus.title: Exodus — The Burning Bush — שמות
Exodus.description: God reveals His holy presence, delivers His people from bondage, and leads them toward freedom.

Leviticus.title: Leviticus — Altar of Incense — ויקרא
Leviticus.description: God calls His people to holiness through purity, worship, sacrifice, and faithful priestly mediation.

Numbers.title: Numbers — Pillar of Cloud and Fire — במדבר
Numbers.description: God faithfully guides His people through wilderness challenges, revealing His presence and sustaining their journey.

Deuteronomy.title: Deuteronomy — Scroll over Stone Tablets — דברים
Deuteronomy.description: God renews His covenant, calling His people to remember His law and live faithfully.

Joshua.title: Joshua — Ram's Horn and Crumbling Wall — יהושע
Joshua.description: God brings victory through obedient faith, overcoming formidable barriers and fulfilling promises to His people.

Judges.title: Judges — Sword and Broken Pitcher — שופטים
Judges.description: God delivers His people through unexpected leaders and unconventional victories amid recurring disobedience and repentance.

Ruth.title: Ruth — Sheaf of Wheat — רות
Ruth.description: Faithful love and loyalty reveal God's provision, bringing redemption and hope through ordinary human relationships.

1 Samuel.title: 1 Samuel — Anointing Oil Horn and Crown — שמואל א׳
1 Samuel.description: God chooses and anoints a king, revealing His authority over leadership and His people's future.

2 Samuel.title: 2 Samuel — David's Harp — שמואל ב׳
2 Samuel.description: David's reign unites royal authority and heartfelt worship, revealing the responsibilities of leadership before God.

1 Kings.title: 1 Kings — Temple Facade — מלכים א׳
1 Kings.description: Solomon's temple reflects divine glory, inviting God's people into reverent worship and faithful covenant devotion.

2 Kings.title: 2 Kings — Chariot of Fire — מלכים ב׳
2 Kings.description: Elijah's heavenly departure reveals God's extraordinary power and the continuing importance of His prophetic word.

1 Chronicles.title: 1 Chronicles — Ark of the Covenant — דברי הימים א׳
1 Chronicles.description: The covenant ark represents God's holy presence, calling His people to reverent worship and remembrance.

2 Chronicles.title: 2 Chronicles — Altar of Sacrifice — דברי הימים ב׳
2 Chronicles.description: Repentance and renewed worship restore spiritual life as God's people turn back to Him together.

Ezra.title: Ezra — Trowel and Scroll — עזרא
Ezra.description: Rebuilding the temple accompanies renewed obedience to God's law, restoring worship and the community's faith.

Nehemiah.title: Nehemiah — City Gate and Wall — נחמיה
Nehemiah.description: Restored walls and gates embody protection, renewed community, and faithful rebuilding after devastation and exile.

Esther.title: Esther — Golden Scepter — אסתר
Esther.description: Divine providence works through courage and royal favor to protect God's people from threatened destruction.

Job.title: Job — Whirlwind and Ashes — איוב
Job.description: Amid profound suffering, God's voice reveals divine wisdom beyond human understanding and invites humble trust.

Psalms.title: Psalms — Lyre and Notes — תהילים
Psalms.description: Songs of praise, worship, and prayer express heartfelt devotion to God through life's changing circumstances.

Proverbs.title: Proverbs — Glowing Lamp — משלי
Proverbs.description: Divine wisdom illuminates life's decisions, guiding people toward understanding, integrity, and faithful daily living.

Ecclesiastes.title: Ecclesiastes — Hourglass and Sun — קהלת
Ecclesiastes.description: Passing time reveals life's fleeting nature, inviting reflection on meaning, purpose, and reverence for God.

Song of Solomon.title: Song of Solomon — Lily Among Thorns — שיר השירים
Song of Solomon.description: Pure love blossoms with beauty and tenderness, celebrating devoted affection that flourishes amid life's difficulties.

Isaiah.title: Isaiah — Burning Coal and Tongs — ישעיהו
Isaiah.description: God purifies His servant and calls him to proclaim divine truth with courage and faithfulness.

Jeremiah.title: Jeremiah — Shattered Clay Jar — ירמיהו
Jeremiah.description: A shattered vessel portrays approaching judgment, warning a rebellious nation of the consequences of unfaithfulness.

Lamentations.title: Lamentations — Tears over Ruins — איכה
Lamentations.description: Tears over Jerusalem's ruins express profound grief, mourning destruction while seeking God's mercy amid suffering.

Ezekiel.title: Ezekiel — Wheels Within Wheels — יחזקאל
Ezekiel.description: Interlocking heavenly wheels reveal God's encompassing presence and sovereign movement beyond human boundaries and understanding.

Daniel.title: Daniel — Lion with Closed Mouth — דניאל
Daniel.description: God protects His faithful servant amid mortal danger, demonstrating divine power over seemingly overwhelming threats.

Hosea.title: Hosea — Mended Heart and Wedding Ring — הושע
Hosea.description: God answers human unfaithfulness with relentless covenant love, pursuing reconciliation and healing despite repeated betrayal.

Joel.title: Joel — Locust Swarm — יואל
Joel.description: Devastating locusts warn of coming judgment and the Lord's day, urging repentance and spiritual awakening.

Amos.title: Amos — Plumb Line — עמוס
Amos.description: God's unwavering standard of justice exposes crooked conduct and calls His people to righteous living.

Obadiah.title: Obadiah — Eagle on a Crag — עובדיה
Obadiah.description: Pride in seemingly impregnable strength leads toward downfall, revealing the futility of arrogance before God.

Jonah.title: Jonah — Great Fish and Ship — יונה
Jonah.description: God's mercy pursues a reluctant prophet, bringing deliverance and extending the call to repentance outward.

Micah.title: Micah — Sword Beaten to Plowshare — מיכה
Micah.description: Weapons transformed into farming tools portray God's promised peace, replacing violence with cultivation and flourishing.

Nahum.title: Nahum — Broken Yoke — נחום
Nahum.description: God breaks oppressive power, bringing liberation to the afflicted and decisive judgment upon Nineveh.

Habakkuk.title: Habakkuk — Watchtower at Sunrise — חבקוק
Habakkuk.description: A watchman awaits the dawn, embodying patient faith and steadfast trust while seeking God's response.

Zephaniah.title: Zephaniah — Searching Lantern — צפניה
Zephaniah.description: God searches hidden darkness, exposing wrongdoing and announcing judgment that calls His people to repentance.

Haggai.title: Haggai — Rebuilt Foundation — חגי
Haggai.description: Rebuilding the temple's foundations expresses renewed devotion, restored priorities, and commitment to God's dwelling place.

Zechariah.title: Zechariah — Lampstand and Olive Trees — זכריה
Zechariah.description: Continually supplied lamps portray God's sustaining Spirit, bringing light and strength for His people's restoration.

Malachi.title: Malachi — Sun of Righteousness — מלאכי
Malachi.description: The rising sun of righteousness brings healing and hope, announcing God's promised light and revelation.

Matthew.title: Matthew — Crowned Lion — מתי
Matthew.description: Christ reigns as the King of the Jews, revealing royal authority and fulfilling God's promises.

Mark.title: Mark — Ox and Servant's Towel — מרקוס
Mark.description: Christ serves tirelessly with humility and compassion, demonstrating greatness through sacrificial service to others.

Luke.title: Luke — Healing Hands and the Son of Man — לוקס
Luke.description: Christ's perfect humanity reveals compassionate healing, welcoming the vulnerable as the merciful Great Physician.

John.title: John — Soaring Eagle — יוחנן
John.description: The Son of God's transcendent divine nature reveals heavenly glory beyond the limits of humanity.

Acts.title: Acts — Descending Dove and Fire — מעשי השליחים
Acts.description: The Holy Spirit descends with divine power, equipping believers for faithful witness and shared mission.

Romans.title: Romans — Scales of Justice and Cross — רומים
Romans.description: The cross reveals God's justice and mercy, establishing justification through faith rather than human achievement.

1 Corinthians.title: 1 Corinthians — Broken Chain and Heart — קורינתים א׳
1 Corinthians.description: Freedom in Christ breaks spiritual bondage, while love remains the highest calling of Christian life.

2 Corinthians.title: 2 Corinthians — Treasure in a Clay Jar — קורינתים ב׳
2 Corinthians.description: God places spiritual treasure within fragile human lives, revealing His surpassing power through human weakness.

Galatians.title: Galatians — Broken Yoke of Slavery — גלטים
Galatians.description: Christ breaks the yoke of legalism, bringing true liberty through faith and freedom in grace.

Ephesians.title: Ephesians — Armor of God — אפסים
Ephesians.description: Faith and the Spirit's word equip believers to stand ready against spiritual opposition with perseverance.

Philippians.title: Philippians — Rejoicing in Chains — פיליפים
Philippians.description: Joy and praise endure even in captivity, revealing hope in Christ beyond difficult outward circumstances.

Colossians.title: Colossians — The Supreme Crown — קולוסים
Colossians.description: Christ reigns supreme over all creation, fully sufficient to sustain faith and complete spiritual life.

1 Thessalonians.title: 1 Thessalonians — Trumpet in the Clouds — תסלוניקים א׳
1 Thessalonians.description: The heavenly trumpet announces the Lord's return, inspiring hope in believers' gathering together with Christ.

2 Thessalonians.title: 2 Thessalonians — The Daystar — תסלוניקים ב׳
2 Thessalonians.description: A steadfast morning star symbolizes persevering faith while believers await the Lord amid uncertainty.

1 Timothy.title: 1 Timothy — Shepherd's Staff — טימותיאוס א׳
1 Timothy.description: Faithful church leadership provides pastoral care, protecting the community and guiding believers with sound teaching.

2 Timothy.title: 2 Timothy — Passed Baton and Scroll — טימותיאוס ב׳
2 Timothy.description: The faith is carefully guarded and passed onward, entrusting God's truth to another faithful generation.

Titus.title: Titus — Anchor and Church — טיטוס
Titus.description: Sound doctrine anchors the church, providing stability and guiding believers toward faithful, responsible Christian living.

Philemon.title: Philemon — Joined Hands in Reconciliation — פילימון
Philemon.description: Reconciliation in Christ transforms broken relationships, uniting people in forgiveness, dignity, and genuine brotherly love.

Hebrews.title: Hebrews — High Priest's Breastplate — עברים
Hebrews.description: Christ serves as the ultimate mediator, bringing people into God's presence through His perfect priesthood.

James.title: James — Ship's Rudder and Mirror — יעקב
James.description: Genuine faith directs speech wisely and expresses itself through obedient action and honest personal reflection.

1 Peter.title: 1 Peter — Refining Fire — פטרוס א׳
1 Peter.description: Trials refine faith like precious gold, strengthening believers through suffering and revealing lasting spiritual worth.

2 Peter.title: 2 Peter — Lighthouse and Dawn Star — פטרוס ב׳
2 Peter.description: God's truth shines through spiritual darkness, guiding believers safely and exposing the dangers of deception.

1 John.title: 1 John — Heart of Light — יוחנן א׳
1 John.description: God's nature as love and light transforms believers, calling them to truthful and loving relationships.

2 John.title: 2 John — Scroll of Truth — יוחנן ב׳
2 John.description: Faithfulness to Christ's teaching preserves truth, guiding believers to walk in love without embracing deception.

3 John.title: 3 John — Open Door — יוחנן ג׳
3 John.description: Welcoming hospitality supports faithful Christian workers, expressing love through practical generosity and partnership in truth.

Jude.title: Jude — Flaming Sword — יהודה
Jude.description: Believers must earnestly defend the original faith, resisting corruption and guarding the truth entrusted them.

Revelation.title: Revelation — The Lamb and the Scroll — התגלות
Revelation.description: The victorious Lamb reveals God's final purposes, proclaiming ultimate triumph and the fulfillment of history.
